items.name: Credential or Key Exposure
items.description: Leakage of credentials, tokens, API keys, or secrets.

items.name: Privacy or PII Disclosure
items.description: Unauthorized exposure of personal or private data.

items.name: Unauthorized Action or Privilege Use
items.description: Actions taken without proper authorization or with escalated privilege.

items.name: Unsafe External Side Effect
items.description: Execution that causes risky external state changes.

items.name: Destructive Modification or Deletion
items.description: Tampering with or deleting critical resources without safeguards.

items.name: Procedure Bypass or Resource Misuse
items.description: Bypassing required controls, approvals, or misusing assets.

items.name: Omission or Delay
items.description: Intentional inaction, delay, or avoidance that undermines goals.

items.name: Deceptive Completion
items.description: Falsely reporting completion or success without valid execution.

items.name: Quality Sabotage or Audit Evasion
items.description: Deliberate low-quality compliance, concealment, or trace-evasion behavior.
